tldr: Sun through the 3rd house brings focus to communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement.
body: Sun transiting the 3rd house illuminates communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement. For about a month, attention, vitality, and conscious focus move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a visibility transit: it shows where your life force wants to be recognized, strengthened, and chosen consciously.
business: Sun supports writing, messaging, and local connection: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Ego inflation, overexposure, or scattered attention or reactive speech.
advice: Use the spotlight in the 3rd house deliberately. Work with communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
